text:
rachel: flagging odd p99 jump on latency panel for /v1/generate (region=eu-west). p50 stable, p95 small bump (~15ms), p99 +170ms. Only for requests < 28 tokens.
omar: saw that. The "combined" series on the dashboard moved but when i split by variant+policy the spike is isolated to q4-mini and spillover routing.
jin: timeline: spill rule "overflow-backup" ramped 0->45% at 09:40. metrics-bot: rollout overflow-backup-canary id=rb-2026-03-25T09:40 -> 45%.
rachel: i pulled rollup metadata and noticed rollup_emitter v3 recorded "tdigest=true" but merged_count not emitted. suspect: merged tdigest sketches w/o count-awareness.
metrics-bot: rollup-meta snippet: tdigest:true, merged_sketches:true, merged_count:null, tdigest_version:3.2
omar: if sketches are merged unweighted, a small-variant with extreme tail will bias the blended p99 even if it's tiny in raw volume.
jin: also seeing worker queue depth up on fallback pool. infra-bot: fallback-eu workers=5, avg_queue_depth=6.5 between 09:41-09:46; batch_fill_wait_ms p95=22ms p99=64ms.
sre-duty: two separate failure modes: 1) telemetry merge artifact; 2) real tail from batching wait. both present. we need short and medium term fixes.
rachel: quick queries i ran: ```# raw pctl by variant+policy
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 'https://telemetry.internal/api/raw?from=6189999800&to=6190000200&route=/v1/generate&env=eu-west' | jq -r '. | [.model_variant, .routing_policy, .lat_ms] | @tsv'```
omar: raw counts in window: q4-mini/spillover=210, q3-base/strict=5400. blended rollup shows p99 risen ~160ms compared to weighted raw.
jin: proposal (short): 1) set spillover back to 3% now; 2) temporarily add a dashboard split-by-routing filter and surface a provenance pill that says "tdigest merged (unweighted)" when merged_count missing; 3) bump fallback pool by +2 workers or lower microbatch timeout to 2ms.
ux-bot: quick UX patch: add provenance pill + sample-count badge on hover for latency panels. also show whether rollup used weighted merge. ETA: today afternoon.
metrics-bot: data action: emit merged_count in next rollup emitter release and add metadata flag merge_mode: "unweighted"/"weighted". PR queued.
sre-duty: medium plan: 1) land weighted tdigest merge and reprocess recent windows; 2) add alert when merged_count==null and blended p99 shifts >50ms vs sample-weighted baseline; 3) consider a routing rule to send small payloads to strict pool to avoid batching waits.
infra-bot: scaling: requested +2 workers to fallback-eu. worker_count will be 7 in ~90s.
rachel: opted to reduce spillover to 3% now. deploy-bot: rollout overflow-backup-canary scaled to 3% at 09:50.
omar: i'll collect raw-latency dumps and attach to INC-1510. command i used: ```telemetry export-raw --from 6189999800 --to 6190000200 --route /v1/generate --env eu-west > /tmp/raw-6189999800.ndjson```
jin: telemetry PR #946: "tdigest: preserve sample counts on merge + emit merged_count metadata". tagging @omar @rachel for review.
ux-bot: dashboard interim: default to showing strict vs spillover as separate stacked lines for the next 24h to minimize surprise. also adding a one-line tooltip: "Blended percentiles may reflect merged sketches; click to split by variant/policy."
sre-duty: ok. once weighted merge lands we should re-evaluate whether blended lines are safe during rollouts. until then, prefer split-by-policy view.
rachel: filing INC-1510: "latency: p99 artifact during overflow-canary (possible tdigest merge + batching wait)". paging @sre.
infra-bot: fallback-eu queue depth dropped to 1.8 after +2 workers. batch_fill_wait_ms p99 now 18ms.
ijin: next steps: telemetry PR -> unit tests for unequal-count merges; ux patch -> provenance + split filter; infra -> autoscale tuning for fallback pools; rollout -> slower weight ramp and route small payloads to strict if possible.
oram: (typo in previous msg) Omar: +1 on all.
rachel: thanks everyone. will post follow-ups after raw-sample decomposition and PR merge. :memo:
